reviews.review_description: If you enjoyed AR Planes or AR Helicopters, this is a brilliant addition now that it includes air combat. Flying a tiny Fokker around living room light fixtures while dodging fire from a SPAD works really well. I took my headset down to the beach, and switching to full-scale mode over the sea was a great touch-the scale feels impressive in open passthrough space. The physics find a nice middle ground between responsive RC handling and realistic flight mechanics, and having actual missions gives it more direction than a typical sandbox fly-around. Overall, it's well-made, with really good detailing on the planes. Definitely a mixed-reality flight game that's worth checking out!

This dev has produced some great - flight mini model simulations, and this is no exception! 

The scaled aircraft visuals are stunning, and the gameplay is great. There are plenty of options to keep you entertained, including Free Flight, Campaign and Battle (Dogfight) modes, with different difficulty levels to suit your skill.

There’s something really rewarding about shooting down your first aircraft in a dogfight! 

Definitely one I would recommend giving a go.

Just simply amazing what the dev has produced again, I took my headset into the garden and had the most epic dog fight around trees and bushes, the mixed reality works well
Planes are very detailed, plane geeks will adore this app.
Highly recommended.
